Added TSA's implemented, limited gateside-access program at 13 airports without inferring national access or measured outcomes.
Restored the September 8 Ahmed jurisdictional dismissal with its five-business-day appeal protection and unresolved merits.
Added the later U.S. and Jordanian missile assessments, unresolved merchant-vessel incidents and Brent's move above $100.
